Class CollectionManager

java.lang.Object
itmo.semyonh.lab5.CollectionManager
public class CollectionManager extends Object
The itmo.semyonh.lab5.CollectionManager class is a central entity that controls the collection `data`, additional data related to that (like `initData`), and handles command execution, that affects underlying data or manager itself (data load/store to a file).
